scripts.build: tsc && vite build && mkdir output 2>nul & xcopy /Y /Q /S dist\* output\dist\ 2>nul
scripts.package: npm run build & pkg . --targets node18-win-x64 --out-path output
scripts.service:install: nssm install weblia output\weblia-tauri.exe & nssm set weblia AppDirectory output & nssm set weblia Start SERVICE_AUTO_START
